title: Quechua MH100 4-person camping tent
description: Pitched tent, poles, pegs and carry bag. Room for four sleeping mats, or two people with extra bags. A little dust around the groundsheet from weekend trips; no missing poles. Happy to walk you through packing it away at pickup. Please return it dry and shake out any sand.

title: Lowe Alpine 65L hiking backpack
description: Roomy trekking pack for a few nights away. Adjustable shoulder straps and padded hip belt; pockets and zips all work. Some light marks on the base from being set down outdoors. Best to try the fit at pickup with a little weight inside. Please empty every pocket before returning.

title: Compact camping stove with carry case
description: Small folding burner for boiling water and simple meals outdoors. Packed in its carry case for easy transport. Fuel is not included, so bring a compatible canister and check the connection with me at pickup. Please let the burner cool completely before packing it away.

title: Naturehike TC02 folding camping wagon
description: Foldable wagon for hauling tents, coolers and bags from the car to a campsite. The fabric tub folds into the frame for transport. We can check the wheels and handle at pickup. Please empty it and brush off any dirt before returning.
check: Frame, wheels and pull handle checked

title: Kairos kayak with paddle
description: Single kayak with seat and paddle, ready for a weekend on the water. Normal surface scuffs from launching and storage. This is a bulky item: please arrange suitable transport before booking. We can check the seat and paddle together at collection. Rinse off salt water before returning.

title: Folding picnic table with four stools
description: Aluminium table and four folding stools for a picnic or extra seating. Folds down for transport; minor scuffs on the legs from storage. Please check that it fits your car before booking. I will show you the folding mechanism at collection. Wipe the top and dry the legs before return.

title: JBL PartyBox speaker
description: Portable party speaker for a small gathering or a weekend celebration. Power lead included; connect your own phone for music. Some handling marks on the casing. We can test playback together at pickup. Keep it dry and check the venue has a suitable power point. Microphones are not included.

title: MUSYSIC LED PAR stage light
description: Compact colour wash light for a DJ corner, dance floor or party backdrop. Includes its mounting bracket and power lead. We can test the built-in colour modes at pickup. Bring your own DMX controller and cable if you want to run it from a lighting desk.
check: Light, power lead and bracket checked

title: Stainless-steel buffet chafing dish
description: Food warmer with lid, food tray, water pan and stand for a home buffet. Light utensil marks from previous events. Fuel and serving utensils are not included. Please check the tray size suits your setup at pickup, and return all parts washed, cooled and dried.

title: Countertop popcorn machine
description: Popcorn machine for a movie night or small party. Collection includes the machine and power cable; bring your own corn, oil and serving bags. A little cosmetic wear on the outside. We will check that it powers on at handover. Please clean out leftover kernels after it has cooled.

title: Neon-print photo backdrop and frame
description: Portable backdrop frame with a neon-style printed cloth for portraits or a party photo corner. Everything packs down for collection. The cloth may need a light steam after transport. Props, camera and lighting are not included. Best used indoors; please check the space you need before booking.

title: Pair of brown folding chairs
description: Two folding chairs for extra guests or a home gathering. Brown seats with a metal frame and normal signs of use. They fold flat, so please bring enough space to carry both. No delivery. We can check the hinges at pickup; please return the seats wiped down.

title: Makita cordless drill and driver kit
description: Drill and driver in their carry case, with charger and batteries. Useful for small DIY jobs and assembling furniture. Some wear on the case; bring the bits suited to your job. I will demonstrate the controls at pickup. Please return both tools, the charger and all batteries together.
check: Both tools, batteries and charger counted

title: Fixnow portable pressure washer
description: Portable washer with hose and spray attachments for a weekend clean. Some marks on the casing from storage. Check the water connection and power requirements with me before booking. We will run through the attachments at pickup. Please drain the hose and let everything dry before return.

title: Compact telescopic ladder
description: Aluminium telescopic ladder that collapses for storage and transport. Orange and black fittings, with light storage scuffs. Please check the extended height suits your job at collection. We will inspect the locking sections together. Carry and use it on a firm, level surface; return it clean and dry.

title: Digital stud and metal finder
description: Handheld wall scanner with a clear display for locating studs and metal before a small DIY job. Light use around the house. Please test it on your wall and check the instructions before relying on a reading. We can check it powers on at pickup. Return it with its battery cover fitted.

title: Simplus carpet and upholstery cleaner
description: Portable fabric cleaner for small rugs, sofa cushions and spot cleaning. Includes its hose and cleaning head. Normal marks on the tanks from use. Cleaning solution is not supplied; check your fabric care instructions first. Please empty and rinse both tanks and flush the head before returning.

title: Brother PX-200 sewing machine
description: Home sewing machine for repairs and small craft projects. Foot pedal and power lead included. Bring your own thread and fabric; please try a sample stitch at pickup so you are comfortable with the controls. Some cosmetic yellowing from age. Return with the needle area brushed clean.

title: Lightweight folding baby stroller
description: Foldable stroller for visiting family or a short trip. Includes the stroller as pictured; other travel accessories are not included. Fabric has normal signs of use and wheels roll smoothly. Please inspect the harness and folding mechanism with me at pickup and check it suits your child before booking.

title: Joie Illusion travel cot
description: Foldable travel cot with its included changing attachment. Handy when family visits. Normal light wear from storage; bedding is not supplied. We will practise opening and locking the frame at pickup. Please check the dimensions and suitability for your child, and return the fabric clean and dry.

title: Teal and navy child car seat
description: Teal and dark-blue child seat for a visiting relative or short trip. Normal cosmetic wear. Please inspect the model label, harness and installation instructions before booking to confirm it suits your child and car. Installation is your responsibility; I can show you the supplied parts at collection.

title: 16-inch kids bicycle
description: Red 16-inch bicycle for a child learning to ride. Visible marks on the frame from use, with working brakes and tyres. Please check the fit at pickup. Helmet and transport are not included. We will check the wheels and brakes together before you take it away.

title: Baby carrier
description: Soft baby carrier for a short outing or visiting family. All straps and buckles are included; fabric has been washed between uses. Please inspect the label and try the fit before booking. I will show you how it packs down at pickup. Return washed according to the care label and fully dry.

title: Joie Mimzy Snacker folding high chair
description: Folding high chair for family visits and short stays. Includes the removable tray and harness. We can check the tray latch and show how the frame folds at pickup. Please wipe down the seat and tray before returning.
check: Tray latch, harness and frame checked

title: Fujifilm X-S10 camera and lenses
description: Camera kit for a weekend of photos. Collection includes the camera and the lenses shown; we will count the caps and accessories together. Memory cards are not included. Kept in a dry cabinet between rentals. Please test the controls at pickup and return it in its bag, away from moisture.

title: HY300 Pro portable projector
description: Compact projector for a casual movie night in a dark room. Remote and power lead included; bring your own source device and check the input connection before booking. This is a budget home projector rather than a daylight presentation unit. Happy to demonstrate the image at pickup.

title: Logitech G29 racing wheel and pedals
description: Force-feedback steering wheel and three-pedal set for a racing weekend or trying a sim setup. Includes power and USB leads. Bring your own compatible PlayStation or PC, game and sturdy desk or wheel stand. We can check steering and pedal input at pickup.
check: Wheel clamp, pedals and cables checked

title: DJI Mini 4 Pro drone
description: Drone for someone already familiar with flying this model. We will check the controller, batteries and included accessories together at pickup. Memory card is not supplied. Light handling marks from previous use. Please discuss the planned rental dates and return the kit clean, packed and complete.

title: GoPro HERO waterproof action camera
description: Entry-level GoPro HERO for a simple outdoor recording setup. This is the older 2014 model, not a recent HERO Black. We will check the controls, case and included mounts at collection. Bring your own compatible memory card. Please rinse the outer case after use near salt water and dry it before return.

title: Meta Quest 2 128GB VR headset
description: Standalone VR headset for trying a few games over the weekend. Headset and controllers included. Some normal wear on the straps. We will check the display and controls at pickup; software purchases are not included. Please sign out of your account and wipe the contact surfaces before return.

title: BioloMix BM1902 5L stand mixer
description: Stand mixer for a weekend baking project. Includes the bowl and the attachments shown in the photos; we will count them at pickup. Some marks around the bowl from regular use. Bring your own ingredients and check your recipe size suits the bowl. Return the removable parts washed and dried.

title: Tefal XL 4.2L air fryer
description: Air fryer for a short stay or trying out a recipe before buying one. Basket and power lead included, with light marks from normal use. We can check the controls at pickup. Food, liners and utensils are not supplied. Please let it cool and clean the basket before returning.

title: Mistral MDH1202D 12L dehumidifier
description: Compact dehumidifier for a room during a humid week. Includes its water tank; normal marks on the casing from moving it around. Please check the room size and operating instructions before booking. We will test the controls at collection. Empty and dry the tank before bringing it back.

title: Tefal Easygliss Plus steam iron
description: Steam iron for a short stay or a batch of event outfits. Lightly used and stored indoors. Ironing board is not included. Please check the garment care label and water instructions before use. We will check the cable and soleplate at pickup. Empty the tank and let it cool before return.

title: Severin RG2366 raclette party grill
description: Tabletop grill with a natural-stone cooking surface and small raclette pans. Good for a relaxed dinner with friends. Food and extension leads are not included. We will count the pans and check the power lead at collection. Please let the stone cool fully before cleaning and packing it.

title: Panasonic SD-P104 bread maker
description: Bread maker for trying fresh loaves at home. Includes its bread pan and kneading paddle. The casing has visible signs of use, but controls work. Bring your own ingredients and use a recipe suited to this model. I can show you how the pan locks in at pickup.

title: Seated electric scooter
description: Seated electric scooter for a short rental, with its charger. This is an older unit with normal cosmetic wear; please test the controls and brakes at pickup. Check the size and your planned route before booking. Helmet is not included. Return it dry, with the charger and supplied parts.

title: Decathlon folding bicycle
description: Folding bicycle for a weekend ride or trying a foldie before buying. Some frame marks from use. We will check the folding catch, brakes and tyres together at pickup. Helmet and transport bag are not included. Please wipe it down after a wet ride and return it folded carefully.

title: Meedo 360L roof box with roof rack
description: Roof storage box with its matching rack, for a trip with extra luggage. Cosmetic scuffs from past use. Please discuss your vehicle and mounting setup before booking; compatibility is not guaranteed. We will check the locks and supplied fittings together at collection. Bring suitable transport for pickup.

title: Three-piece black luggage set
description: Matching black suitcases in three sizes for a family trip. Wheels and handles work; shells have normal travel marks. Please check the sizes fit your airline allowance. We will count the cases and inspect the zips together at pickup. Empty every pocket and wipe down the wheels before returning.
check: Three cases, zips and wheels checked

title: Vacuum cleaner
description: Easy to use vacuum for house work
check: Power, hose and dust compartment checked

title: Toolbox
description: A full fledged toolbox to help any of your house work needs
check: Tool inventory and case latch checked

title: Portable commercial induction cooktop
description: Single-burner induction cooktop for a pop-up stall or an extra cooking station at an event. Bring induction-compatible cookware and confirm your venue has a suitable outlet before booking. We can test the controls at pickup. Please return the cooktop cool and wiped clean.
check: Cooking surface, controls and power lead checked
